dutchPay.title: Dutch Pay Calculator
dutchPay.description: Split meals and trips with weighted shares and item participants. Check whether settlements were saved, and select or retry the full text when copying fails.

howItWorks.title: How it works
items: Each item is split among its participants by share weight. E.g. 35,000 KRW at 1.5x/1x/1x = 15,000/10,000/10,000.
Leftover won from division are assigned 1 KRW at a time (largest remainder first) so each item sums exactly.
When one person paid, everyone else's amount is rounded to the chosen unit and the organizer absorbs the difference.
When several paid, net balance = paid − share; the largest debtor is matched with the largest creditor repeatedly (at most people − 1 transfers).

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Choose whether one or several people paid, then enter people, amounts and participants for each item.
Choose weights and rounding, then review each person's share and transfer amount.
Copy an amount, notice or settlement link. If copying fails, select the full text shown or retry.
Check that saving was confirmed. A saved settlement replaces the current form only when you load it.
An optional account updates the current notice immediately. If device saving fails or another tab changes it, recheck or retry while keeping your current input.

tips.title: Tips
items: Settlement names and expenses are reflected in the existing share URL. View-only mode limits the editing UI; it is not encryption or access control.
The account is excluded from settlement links, saved settlements and view-only notices. It may be included in notices copied or explicitly shared from the editor.
Keep up to 10 recent settlements. If the current link format cannot restore every value, the form is kept and saving is rejected.
An unconfirmed save may already have written data. Do not treat it as confirmed; recheck as instructed.
Multiple-payer settlement matches net balances. It does not guarantee the fewest possible transfers in every case.

whatIs.title: What is the Dutch Pay Calculator?
whatIs.description: Split expenses paid by one or several people using item exclusions, weights and rounding. Net balances produce a transfer list and a notice. Keep up to 10 supported settlements in this browser; this tool does not send money.

items.q: Can I exclude someone from only one item?
items.a: Tap their name under the participants for that item. Their participation and weight in other items remain unchanged.

items.q: Where does the rounding difference go?
items.a: When one person paid, the amounts sent by everyone else are rounded to the chosen unit. The organizer receives the remaining difference so the full total matches.

items.q: Can I keep calculating if saving fails or a record is damaged?
items.a: The current calculation and copying remain available. Damaged stored text is not overwritten automatically, and the affected storage feature shows its status. Clicking Save alone is not treated as success.

items.q: Do the account and records go into share links?
items.a: The link includes settlement people and expenses. It excludes the account, as do saved settlements. Notices copied or explicitly shared from the editor may include the account, so review them before sending.

items.q: Can I save a settlement with many items?
items.a: The form's item list and the storage format have different limits. The current format supports up to 100 items. More items or any values changed by a round trip are rejected for saving while the current form is kept.
It provides calculations, notices and copying only. Review the amounts, then send money yourself using your bank or payment app.

storage.loadHint: Loading replaces the current settlement. Your account input stays unchanged.
storage.recheckHint: This checks the saved state only. Your current settlement and account input stay unchanged.
storage.changed: The previous load was cancelled because your input changed.
storage.unavailable: Device storage is unavailable. The current contents stay on screen.
storage.corrupt: The saved contents could not be read safely. The original is preserved and saving for this item is paused.
storage.tooLarge: The saved contents exceed the reading limit. The original and your current input are preserved.
storage.unsupported: This saved format is not supported. The original was not changed.
storage.unsupportedState: This settlement cannot be saved without losing data. Check the limits of 30 people, 100 items, and the input fields. Your current settlement is preserved.
storage.quota: There is not enough device storage to save. Your current input is preserved.
storage.conflict: The saved contents changed in another screen. Check the saved state again.
storage.unconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. It may already be saved, so check the saved state again.
storage.accountSaved: Saved on this device. It is not included in the shared link.
storage.accountDirty: You can use this account input on the current screen, but it is not yet saved on this device.
storage.accountFailed: Your account input stays on this screen. You can retry saving it on this device.
